decisions: IF-introduced bindings last through IF condition and matching THEN group only.
Standalone typed instance selector bindings remain available through following statements of the same CFEL block.
Mixed AND/OR requires explicit parentheses without implicit precedence.
Quote text only when needed using double quotes; quoted text uses backslash quote for a literal quote and double backslash for a literal backslash. Other escapes are not authorized.
A new IF binding uses a different variable name from an already bound outer variable; ordinary references retain that binding identity.

candidates.changes: Group one CFEL expression; parentheses do not create a Node or Relation. When AND and OR occur in one Boolean expression, use parentheses to make their grouping explicit; neither has implicit precedence over the other.
candidates.limits: No claim about outer variable lifetime, shadowing or new syntax.

candidates.change: Use == for asserted root level and THEN conclusion in the existing formula; binding and formula grammar remain separate held checks.
